Overview

Where the sea
meets luxury

Brand Identity Visual System Web Design Print Collateral Welcome Kit Hotel Assets

L'Azure Hospitality is a premium hotel group operating luxury properties along the Saudi Red Sea coast, including Royal L'Azure Resort and Sharma Resort. The brand required a cohesive visual identity that evokes the calm of water, the warmth of sand, and the depth of the sea.

We built the identity around a fluid wave symbol — organic, elegant, and instantly recognizable. The mark is rooted in movement and tranquility simultaneously, working beautifully across all touchpoints from embossed stationery to digital interfaces.

The color system pairs Dark Blue (#506580) with Tan Gold (#D8BA9E) — evoking deep water against warm sandy shores — creating an atmosphere that feels both grounded and aspirational.
